sentence: This project supports three linked projects that study cellular senescence in bone, muscle, and brain aging.
This project studies how a kinesin-3 motor generates force and moves along microtubules and what structural defects disease mutations cause.
This project tests MRI methods that map the margins and spread of glioblastoma tumors in the brain.
This project studies how bacterial and viral respiratory pathogens interact with molecules in host cells.
This project designs and tests an RNA therapy that activates the immune system against glioblastoma brain cancer.
This project uses tunable acoustic metamaterials to bend and focus ultrasound in water to improve ultrasound resolution.
This project develops an anti-inflammatory therapy that delivers dexamethasone locally to reduce vein inflammation and scarring in deep vein thrombosis.
This project studies post-transcriptional regulation by small RNA molecules in Acinetobacter baumannii using sequencing and bacterial genetics.
This project tests whether vaccinating stem cell donors helps control cytomegalovirus reactivation in stem cell transplant recipients.
This project uses neuroimaging to study the brain's reward system in autism spectrum disorder and attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder.
This project studies how lysosomes respond when their membranes are damaged.
This project generates standard samples so different groups can compare and combine results on the human virome.
This project maps how heart tissue cells communicate and respond electrically to DNA damage.
This project studies why leukemia stem cells depend on regulated protein synthesis in acute myeloid leukemia.
This project follows youth who have and have not engaged in hazardous drinking to learn how alcohol affects the brain, cognition, and emotion.
This project studies how gene mutations make the immune system overactive and how that kills brain cells, using a mutant fruit fly.
This project combines molecular knowledge of pancreas biology with clinical work to improve outcomes for patients with pancreas cancer.
This project uses MRI data to find biological subtypes of alcohol use disorder and studies their behavioral, genetic, and molecular links.
This project tests whether physical activity measured by a wearable sensor can predict clinical worsening in pediatric pulmonary hypertension.
This project studies what an understudied protein does in cells to learn how alpha-dystroglycanopathies, diseases affecting muscle and brain, arise.
